questions.question: Swimmers finished in 0:58, 1:02, 0:55 and 1:10. Order the times from fastest to slowest and explain.
questions.expected_answer: Change to seconds: 58, 62, 55 and 70. The smallest time is the fastest, so the order is 55, 58, 62, 70, which is 0:55, 0:58, 1:02 and 1:10.

questions.question: 1 October is a Thursday. On which day is 17 October? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Add 7s to find the Thursdays: 8 and 15 October. Counting on from Thursday 15: Friday 16, Saturday 17. So 17 October is a Saturday.

questions.question: Races start every 6 minutes from 09:00. When does the fifth race start?
questions.expected_answer: The races start at 09:00, 09:06, 09:12, 09:18 and 09:24. The fifth race starts at 09:24.
